title: SolarEdge Introduces UL 3141-Certified Commercial Power Control System to Simplify U.S. Commercial Solar Interconnection
body_markdown:
*New inverter-integrated solution supports power export control helping commercial projects expand onsite solar generation while addressing utility interconnection constraints*


**MILPITAS, Calif. — 03 September, 2026** — SolarEdge Technologies, Inc. ("SolarEdge") today introduced its UL 3141-certified Power Control System (PCS), designed to help U.S. commercial and industrial solar developers and installers simplify utility interconnection while expanding onsite solar generation. The certification includes Power Export Limit and Non-Export Control functions.


As businesses electrify operations and add new electrical loads—from EV charging and building electrification to manufacturing expansion and growing computing demand—many are looking to install additional solar capacity to offset rising energy consumption. At the same time, utilities are adopting increasingly stringent interconnection requirements, making it more difficult and costly for commercial projects to expand while maintaining existing grid connections.


Addressing these constraints has often required additional control equipment, custom engineering and electrical infrastructure upgrades.


SolarEdge's Commercial UL3141 PCS addresses these challenges by integrating certified power control directly into the SolarEdge inverter. Unlike traditional power control approaches that often rely on external controllers and customized system architectures, the solution provides a standardized approach designed to simplify deployment, streamline the utility interconnection process, support utility-required export limits and reduce the need for certain transformer, switchgear or electrical-service upgrades—helping improve overall project economics.


*"Commercial customers want to get the most value from their solar investments without adding unnecessary cost, complexity or engineering," said Kleber Facchini, Sr. Director of C&I Products and Applications for SolarEdge North America. "Our UL 3141-certified Commercial Power Control System gives installers a simpler way to address export constraints and design systems around a customer's changing energy needs. As electricity demand continues to grow, we're helping businesses expand onsite solar generation while making better use of their existing electrical infrastructure."*


By combining inverter-integrated power control with SolarEdge's commercial system architecture, the solution can also help reduce balance-of-system requirements through longer strings and fewer system components. This can simplify system design, reduce associated equipment and installation costs, and help improve overall project economics, depending on project configuration.


In California, the solution is designed to support commercial non-export and export limit applications, including eligible projects pursuing Rule 21 non-export intercon​nection pathways. It can also support certain system expansions while preserving existing intercon​nection terms, including NEM 2.0 status where applicable and subject to utility approval.


The SolarEdge UL 3141-certified Commercial Power Control System is now available for orders for eligible synergy Inverters (SExxK-USxxIxxx4, SE-DBL-US00IBNx4, SE-TRI-US00IBNx4), and three-phase Inverters (SExxK-USxxIxxZ4, USE-SIN-USR0IBNSx 1, FW Version: 4.25.509 or newer).
